channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: STF libera plano de dados para combate a desinformação a 72h da eleição
item.description: The STF unanimously approved a data plan to combat misinformation 72 hours before the 2026 elections, in a historic ruling that brought together all justices, including Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça. The measure aims to contain fake news and ensure the integrity of the electoral process.

item.title: Globo não fez debates em 94 e 98; FHC venceu no 1º turno, e Lula reclamou
item.description: The cancellation of Globo's presidential debate revives criticism about the absence of debates in 1994 and 1998, elections in which FHC won in the first round and Lula questioned transparency. The incident reopens discussions about the media's role in election coverage and the importance of presidential debates for Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Mendonça manda apagar posts que ligam Flávio a Nossa Senhora
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of posts linking presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro to support for stripping Nossa Senhora Aparecida of her title as Brazil's patron saint.

item.title: PF planeja criar divisão de combate a bets ilegais
item.description: The Federal Police plans to create a specialized division to combat illegal gambling, with approval from President Lula. The directorate restructuring aims to strengthen repression of this type of criminal activity in the country.

item.title: Ao fechar consulados, EUA tentam criar narrativa de instabilidade na eleição brasileira
item.description: The U.S. Embassy in Brazil decided to close its consulates during the 2026 elections, an action interpreted as an interference attempt to create a narrative of instability in the country. Brazilian authorities view the measure as a 'factoid' without real security risks justifying the suspension of diplomatic services.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: TV Globo é alvo de censura do TSE e do STF; eleições livres acabaram?
item.description: The program Meio-Dia em Brasília discusses the cancellation of the TV Globo presidential debate, questioning censorship by the TSE and STF. The content includes criticism of institutional behavior and raises concerns about electoral freedom in Brazil.

item.title: Governo instala grades de proteção no Palácio do Planalto para as eleições
item.description: The GSI installed fences around the Palácio do Planalto ahead of the first round of the 2026 elections, citing potential nearby protests. The Ministries Esplanade and the Three Powers Plaza will also be closed Sunday for security reinforcement. Candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) held a protest against the STF following the cancellation of a TV Globo debate.

item.title: Nunes Marques reconsidera decisão e autoriza telões em comícios de Lula
item.description: The president of the TSE, Nunes Marques, authorized the use of screens in Lula's rallies, after revisiting a prior decision that banned them. The authorization allows real-time broadcast of the event’s images, but prohibits using the panels as independent advertising materials. The decision balances electoral regulations with transparency requirements in public events.

item.title: Eleições 2026: saiba a ordem dos votos na urna eletrônica
item.description: In the 2026 election, voters will make six choices at the ballot: federal deputy, state deputy, two senators, governor, and president. The order is set by the TSE, and voting takes place from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The electronic ballot includes a security pause for review before confirmation.

item.title: Ministra do TSE que proibiu púlpito vazio na Globo atuou com Dino e já pediu voto a Lula
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha blocked TV Globo from displaying an empty podium for Lula, leading to the cancellation of the presidential debate. Aranha, who previously worked in Flávio Dino's government and publicly supported Lula in 2022, was appointed to the TSE by President Lula. Additional judicial rulings, including the inclusion of Renan Santos and Romeu Zem, also modified the debate format.

item.title: Crusoé: O que os nossos juízes ainda vão aprontar nesta eleição?
item.description: The 2026 election is approaching its first round with Lula in his third term. Judges from the TSE are under pressure to oversee the electoral process. The campaign has been restricted by TSE's strict rules, raising concerns about transparency and freedom of expression.

item.title: Ministra eleitora de Lula no TSE resguardou o presidente, mas penalizou o eleitor
item.description: The TSE electoral minister's decision protected President Lula, prioritizing the collective right over the individual but penalized voters. Electoral justice applied the principle that the collective prevails, sparking criticism about its impact on voter participation.

item.title: Três em cada 10 pessoas no Brasil dizem que redes sociais são obstáculo para democracia, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Pew Research Center survey reveals that 29% of Brazilians consider social media a threat to democracy, while 78% say the internet facilitates manipulation through false information. Despite this, most people value access to information and expanded political participation enabled by digital platforms.

item.title: Eleições 2026: As capas do GLOBO nas datas de nascimento dos principais candidatos à Presidência
item.description: The article connects the births of the main 2026 presidential candidates with key historical and political moments in Brazil, emphasizing how each date overlaps with significant national events. Beyond Lula, Caiado, Cury, Zema, Flávio Bolsonaro and Renan Santos, the text underscores the relationship between each candidate's trajectory and the context in which they were born.

item.title: Fraco desempenho de Caiado e Zema é alerta para futuro de Tarcísio
item.description: The weak performance of Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema in the 2026 presidential polls serves as a warning for Tarcísio de Freitas, who is expected to be reelected in São Paulo. Despite his favorable position, the former governors did not exceed 5% in voting intention, indicating difficulties for candidates with traditional executive management in this polarized scenario. Tarcísio is likely to leave the election even more presidential, but must heed the warning signals from colleagues who also had well-regarded administrations.

item.title: Mendonça orienta plataformas sobre posts do caso Nossa Senhora
item.description: Minister André Mendonça (STF/TSE) instructed digital platforms to remove posts falsely attributing to Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) a proposal to revoke Nossa Senhora Aparecida's title as Brazil's patron saint. Removal is limited to false attributions, preserving political criticism and religious statements. Legal disputes may be reassessed by Electoral Justice.

item.title: O que os governos dos EUA e da Austrália dizem sobre fechamento de embaixadas e consulados no Brasil às vésperas da eleição
item.description: The governments of the United States and Australia closed their embassies and consulates in Brazil on the eve of the 2026 presidential election, whose first round takes place on Sunday. The closure was motivated by security concerns, according to Australia, while the U.S. emphasized the priority of protecting its citizens.

item.title: “Democracias maduras não têm medo de serem observadas”, diz diretora do TSE
item.description: Renata Gil, Director of International Affairs at the TSE, emphasized that mature democracies do not fear external observation, stating that transparency strengthens Brazilian democracy. The court will host international missions to monitor the 2026 elections.

item.title: Cury pede a Fachin que STF preserve a liberdade de expressão nas eleições
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) wrote to Edson Fachin asking the STF to protect freedom of expression and ensure voters' information after the cancellation of TV Globo's debate. Cury criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro's absence, noting 40% of voters are unaware of his candidacy.

item.title: De escolas a tempo integral a ‘homeschooling’: as propostas dos presidenciáveis para a educação
item.description: The 2026 presidential campaign platforms reflect diverse visions of the state's role in education, covering topics such as literacy, early childhood education, technical training, universities, funding, and teacher welfare. Proposals include expanding full-time schooling, integrating high school with professional training, and debates over civic-military schools, homeschooling, quotas, and higher education entry.

item.title: Preferência por Lula, cautela ao criticar Flávio: como a China (e a imprensa local) vê a eleição no Brasil
item.description: Chinese media emphasize that the economy is the central factor in Brazil-China relations regardless of the president's political orientation. They highlight Lula as relevant while showing caution in criticizing Flávio, reflecting a pragmatic stance from both the local press and the Chinese government.

item.title: Transporte gratuito no primeiro turno das eleições: veja como vai funcionar
item.description: Public transportation will be free on election day during the first round of Brazil's 2026 elections, as mandated by the TSE, to ensure voters can reach polling stations. The measure, outlined in TSE Resolution No. 23,751/2026, applies to urban and intercity transit in multiple cities on Sunday, October 4. Candidates and political parties are prohibited from offering transportation to voters.

item.title: Ibovespa sobe 0,73% após payroll fraco nos EUA; eleição mantém cautela
item.description: The Ibovespa rose 0.73% following weak U.S. jobs data, easing pressure on interest rate hikes and providing market relief. Brazil's industrial production fell 0.6% in August, reflecting the impact of high interest rates. The upcoming election keeps investors cautious.

item.title: MP Eleitoral pede multa a Lula, Flávio e outros candidatos a presidente
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry filed lawsuits with the TSE against Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), accusing campaigns of using unregistered digital channels. Additional candidates are also mentioned in the case for irregular propaganda.

item.title: Lula chega a 1,8 milhão simultâneos no Flow; live de Flávio, a 941 mil
item.description: Lula reached 1.8 million simultaneous devices on the Flow Podcast, while Flávio Bolsonaro hit 941,000 in a YouTube livestream. Both opted for their own broadcasts after the Globo presidential debate was canceled. Data comes from a Poder360 survey and does not reflect exact viewer numbers.

item.title: A operação do time de Lula para evitar ampla adesão à campanha de Flávio no segundo turno
item.description: Lula's allies work to prevent defeated first-round candidates from endorsing Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, keeping them neutral. The strategy targets Augusto Cury, with support from figures like Paulo Pereira and Rui Costa, while avoiding action against Caiado, Zema, and Renan Santos.

item.title: Embaixada dos EUA e Austrália suspendem atendimento e alegam ‘questões de segurança’
item.description: The US and Australian embassies in Brazil suspend consular services citing 'security issues' with no timeline for resumption. US citizens are advised to avoid diplomatic facilities and contact on-duty officials. The suspension occurs without detailed explanation amid rising diplomatic tensions.

item.title: Que horas começa a votação? Veja os horários de início e fim do primeiro turno
item.description: Voting for the first round of the 2026 general elections takes place on Sunday, October 4th, from 8am to 5pm Brasília time. The TSE unified voting hours nationwide, with exceptions for some regions using local time zones such as Rondônia, Mato Grosso, Acre, and Fernando de Noronha. Voters can cast ballots for all positions: president, governor, senators, federal and state deputies, with a potential runoff on October 25th for tied races.

item.title: Mídia tradicional critica STF e TSE por melarem debate da “Globo”
item.description: Newspapers Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo criticized STF and TSE decisions that led to the cancellation of TV Globo's presidential debate, alleging censorship and disrespect for press freedom. Minister Estela Aranha and Justice Gilmar Mendes complied with party requests to change debate rules, generating reactions from candidates and broadcasters.

item.title: Mendonça manda redes apagarem posts sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of social media posts linking PL presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro or his family to the alleged revocation of Nossa Senhora Aparecida’s title as Brazil’s patron saint. The measure aims to prevent misinformation and protect the candidate’s image, though it raises concerns about freedom of expression.

item.title: Sem debate e com duelo de lives, Lula bate Flávio no YouTube
item.description: Without the TV Globo debate, Lula and Flávio held simultaneous YouTube live streams, with the president leading in concurrent viewership. The broadcast served as an alternative after the televised debate was canceled.

item.title: No Flow, Lula ataca Flávio e lobista e defende Lulinha e Jaques Wagner
item.description: Lula attacked Flávio Bolsonaro and lobbyists on the Flow Podcast after deciding not to debate on TV Gloabo. He supported Lulinha and Jaques Wagner, using derogatory terms like 'mequetrefe' against his opponent. The broadcast reached over 1.6 million viewers.

item.title: Lula diz duvidar de que Congresso reverta proibição de bets no Brasil
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) stated that the National Congress is unlikely to block the MP banning online betting platforms, reaffirming his skepticism about the measure being reversed. He emphasized the government's stance on betting sites.

item.title: Lula avalia proibir bancos de oferecerem mais de um cartão de crédito por pessoa
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva proposed restricting banks to offering only one credit card per person, aiming to curb over-indebtedness among the population. The measure seeks to prevent excessive debt and protect consumers.

item.title: Lula diz que vai tentar mudar formato de emendas no Legislativo se for reeleito presidente
item.description: Lula stated in an interview with Flow Podcast that he intends to reform the parliamentary amendment system and its impact on the federal budget if re-elected in 2026. He emphasized the need to change the Legislative's functioning to ensure better control over public resources.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual pelo Rio Grande do Sul (RS): veja os nomes e os números
item.description: The 2026 elections in Rio Grande do Sul include the race for 55 seats in the state legislature, with candidates identified by five-digit numbers. Voters must verify photo, name, number, and party before confirming their vote, and can check candidate status through the TSE. The content guides the voting process and the importance of following electoral court rules.

item.title: Lula diz que quer proibir bancos de emitirem mais de um cartão por pessoa
item.description: President Lula proposed to the Central Bank a ban on banks issuing more than one credit card per person, aiming to reduce the population's debt burden, which reaches 82% of families. He highlighted credit card interest rates of up to 449.4% and announced the creation of Desenrola 3.0, a program allowing the federal government to purchase debts through auctions and transfer discounts to debtors.

item.title: Lula e Flávio se apegam a pesquisas distintas para sustentar favoritismo
item.description: The campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro rely on different internal polls to support their respective leads, with the PL showing an advantage for the senator and the PT indicating the petista is ahead. Official polls registered with the TSE show a tie between the candidates within the margin of error.

item.title: Lula e Flávio disputam Minas voto a voto na antevéspera da eleição
item.description: Lula and Flávio compete for votes in Minas on the eve of the first round, with Lula walking in Belo Horizonte and Flávio campaigning in Montes Claros. Both seek to strengthen local allies in one of the country's largest electoral colleges.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual pelo Paraná (PR): veja os nomes e os números
item.description: The October 7, 2026 elections will select 54 state deputies in Paraná. Voters must enter 5-digit numbers, verify details, and confirm their votes. Full candidate lists will be published by the TSE and O GLOBO.

item.title: 🚨 LULA AO VIVO HOJE — ELEIÇÕES 2026 | ENTREVISTA, DEBATE E ÚLTIMAS NOTÍCIAS
item.description: The content is a live broadcast discussing the 2026 elections with a focus on Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, addressing potential aspects of his campaign and current political context. The broadcast includes elements of interaction with the audience and may involve debates on topics such as economy, security, and corruption. The live stream aims to present recent news and analysis on the Brazilian electoral scenario.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado federal por São Paulo (SP): veja os nomes e os números
item.description: The 2026 elections in São Paulo will elect 70 federal deputies among 513 candidates. Voting takes place on October 4, using four-digit numbers, and voters must verify photo, name, number, and party before confirming. The candidate list is available on the O GLOBO website, with candidacy statuses at the TSE.

item.title: “Globo” cancela debate presidencial por “insegurança jurídica”
item.description: TV Globo canceled the presidential debate scheduled for October 1, 2026, due to last-minute judicial decisions causing legal uncertainty. The network was barred from displaying Lula's podium and from asking questions to the absent candidate, while also being required to include Renan Santos following a STF decision. The cancellation was justified as a defense of press freedom.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual pelo Rio de Janeiro (RJ): veja os nomes e os números
item.description: The 2026 elections will define 70 seats in the Rio de Janeiro State Legislative Assembly (Alerj), with voting in the first round on October 4. Voters must enter five-digit numbers and confirm candidates after verifying photo, name, number, and party. It is possible to check the list of candidates and their statuses at the Superior Electoral Court (TSE).

item.title: Vira-lata, miliciano e desqualificado: como Lula se referiu a Flávio Bolsonaro em entrevista a podcast
item.description: In an interview with the Flow podcast, Lula criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him 'turncoat', 'militia member', and 'disqualified', questioning his alliance with Trump and ties to militias.

item.title: A ‘surpresa’ de Lula com o sigilo das visitas da ‘Vorcaro feminino’ ao Palácio da Alvorada
item.description: President Lula expressed surprise at the GSI's refusal to disclose lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger's access to the Alvorada Palace. In an interview with the 'Flow' podcast, he also denied knowing the friend of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, investigated for INSS fraud.

item.title: “Tudo que Jaques Wagner quer é depor”, diz Lula sobre caso Master
item.description: President Lula stated that Senator Jaques Wagner has no connection to Banco Master and Credcesta, suggesting Wagner merely wants to testify. Wagner was targeted in the Compliance Zero operation over alleged corruption and money laundering charges.

item.title: Fracasso do Move Motos expõe limites das políticas eleitoreiras
item.description: The Move Motos program, designed to facilitate credit for app delivery drivers, reached only 17,700 beneficiaries out of a potential market of 700,000 to 1.2 million, disappointing government expectations to boost Lula's popularity.

item.title: Horário da eleição: que horas começa e termina a votação do primeiro turno?
item.description: The first round of the 2026 elections takes place between 8am and 5pm (Brasília time) nationwide, with regional adjustments based on time zones. Vote counting begins at 5pm and can be followed live on the Globo website.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aparece numericamente à frente de Lula, aponta pesquisa Vox Brasil
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading in the first round of the 2026 elections with 41.2%, ahead of Lula (PT) at 40.4%, within the margin of error. Lula's rejection increases while Flávio's decreases, and Lula's government approval drops.
